svg.aria-label: Describing function magnitude against input amplitude X for four nonlinearities with unit parameters: saturation (S = 1) falls from 1, dead zone (D/2 = 1) rises from 0 towards 1, the ideal relay (M = 1) falls like 4/(πX), and the relay with dead zone (M = 1, D/2 = 1) peaks at 2/π when X = √2
